visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot showing a pair of hands tearing a golden-brown, round bun in half, revealing a thick yellow custard filling inside. The setting is an indoor kitchen with a wooden table. (2) Hands display a rectangular glass container filled with a white, fermented dough starter. The scene cuts to a stainless steel mixing bowl where a stand mixer's hook is pulling up a stretchy, pale dough. (3) A close-up demonstrates the 'windowpane test,' where a hand stretches a small piece of dough until it is thin and translucent without tearing. (4) The dough is placed in a large metal bowl for fermentation. Then, the fermented dough is placed on a white marble countertop, where a hand uses a yellow plastic scraper to divide it into small portions and rolls them into smooth spheres. (5) A hand presses a dough ball flat on the marble surface. Another hand uses a small metal spatula to place a dollop of thick yellow custard in the center of the flattened dough. (6) The hands pull the edges of the dough toward the center, pinching and twisting to seal the custard inside, forming a smooth round bun. (7) Several dough balls are placed on a black baking tray lined with parchment paper. The scene cuts to the buns being pulled out of a modern silver oven, now fully baked and golden-brown. (8) The hands hold a finished bun over a basket lined with newspaper-print paper, tearing it open once more to show the final baked texture and custard center.
